description:
**Release candidate — please report problems before 1.10.0.**

### New
- **Fix random subreddit**: Random and r/randnsfw open random subreddits again, sourced from redditrand.com.
- **Explain processing videos**: says "Video still processing. Try again in a minute." instead of an error while Reddit is still processing a video.
- **Inline comment images**: tables in comments and text posts are shown inline (setting "Inline tables"). Tap one to open rif's table view.

### Changes
- The settings entry and screen are now called "rif patches".

### Fixes
- Retrying a failed post no longer uploads its media a second time.
- "Reddit is temporarily blocking requests" no longer sticks around after Reddit stops blocking.

### Adding this bundle
To try this release candidate, add `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MojiRS/revanced-rif-patches/main/bundles/latest.json` as a remote patch source in ReVanced Manager (`stable.json` stays on 1.9.0 until 1.10.0). Requires rif is fun **5.6.22** (free or Golden Platinum), patched together with the official ReVanced bundle's **Spoof client** patch. [notBrian2/revanced-rif-fixes](https://github.com/notBrian2/revanced-rif-fixes) is needed alongside it to fix galleries and loading more comments.
